accepted.claim: Resolved USD readback is not independent backend iteration instrumentation
accepted.decision: Already explicit in source recipe/result and independent review. No claim of proving each internal solver iteration.

accepted.claim: Compare rate bias/integrals as an observable even when one-origin gate already passes
accepted.decision: Use unchanged actual recorded channels for post-run analysis; origin screen remains required feasibility/admission, not unique cause discriminator.

accepted.claim: Sleep/contact cache and solver island packing may confound comparison
accepted.decision: Untested hypotheses only. Sensor agent asked to inspect existing support-event zero channels without new GPU/API changes.

accepted.claim: Higher velocity iterations may change physical inputs through derivative feedback
accepted.decision: Qualitatively true because dq enters PD. Distinguish numerical velocity correction and resulting closed-loop torque; no isolated physical cause claim.

rejected_or_corrected.claim: Grid RMS10rad/s and tibia derivative torque1.05Nm explain peak1.16Nm
rejected_or_corrected.correction: Our prompt range shorthand .07..10 was ambiguous. Actual maximum is0.09956584870815277rad/s (~0.07–0.10), not10. A tibia Kd0.1055 times0.1rad/s is0.01055Nm, not1.05Nm. It is invalid to compare that purported RMS contribution with all-joint all-run transient peak. Original prompt/result are preserved.

rejected_or_corrected.claim: No change under255iterations proves velocity iterations inert
rejected_or_corrected.correction: A behavior-noise-floor comparison alone cannot prove parameter nonapplication; no mandatory255 test or unmodified32 repeat is required for the declared bounded hypothesis. Unknown/no-effect outcomes stay unknown.

rejected_or_corrected.claim: Origin passing means one-before32 discriminates nothing
rejected_or_corrected.correction: Same-source one is required to detect a new recipe regression before scaling; it need not isolate causality. Compare signed rates/angle changes as secondary observables without new gate.

rejected_or_corrected.claim: Small angle range alone shows high SDK RMS cannot be actual motion
rejected_or_corrected.correction: Oscillatory angle motion can integrate nearzero. Use actual400Hz angle increments and events; no all-grid nonintegrating claim until those raw arrays are reviewed.

rejected_or_corrected.claim: Counts must be authored before simulation scene exists
rejected_or_corrected.correction: Necessary boundary for this source is before native articulation initialization/warmup. Source004 authors after USD scene construction but before sim.reset, not a live alreadyinitialized GPU edit. No source issue identified.

rejected_or_corrected.claim: None read proves API absent, or sleep hypothesis establishes cause
rejected_or_corrected.correction: None also permits invalidpath/schema/provider issues; fail-closed actualvalues are retained. Sleep cause and native getter availability are not established. Canonical USD already applies PhysxArticulationAPI.

decision: No concrete blocker to the exact source004 solver-only diagnostic. Root retains dispatch/adoption; no physical acceptance or causal proof from this CPU review.
